# Join ESIEE Paris

## Join an ESIEE Paris engineering course or an international programme

[**Engineer programmes (in french or partially in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/join-esiee-paris)

[**Artificial intelligence and cybersecurity (engineering programme 100% in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/master-in-artificial-intelligence-cybersecurity)

[**M.Sc Management of technology information systems (master of science 100% in english)**](/en/apply/apply-engineer/msc-management-of-technology-information-systems)

You are joining an international programme by ESIEE Paris which is 100% in English

The school's admission procedure is based on an application file, an interview and an English test.

* ### What are the prerequisites?

  Foreign students: Bachelor's degree  
   French students: First year of a Master’s degree, or equivalent  
   Each applicant must also provide evidence of a good mastery of English in their application. The minimum level required is as follows:  
   - TOEFL > 580 (PBT)/ 237 (CBT)/ 92 (IBT)  
   - TOEIC > 800  
   - IELTS level 6.5/ 7  
   - Cambridge Advanced English  
    
   These exams are not necessary if all of your secondary and higher education was in English.
* ### Admissions calendar

  Beginning of applications: 1st October 2026  
    
   Application deadline: 31st March 2027  
    
  Admission decision  
  You will receive an email about the decision made by the academic board three weeks maximum after receipt of all application documents.

  Deadline for deposit payment  
  If accepted, in order to secure your admission you will be required to pay a deposit of 6 250 €. This sum will thus be deducted from your overall tuition fees.

  Beginning of classes: 13th September 2027

**Tuition fees 2027/2028**  
  
 €10,500 for the complete programme (for complete 18-month programme)  
 €8,500 for students from partner universities (Check with your international office to see if your university has a partnership with ESIEE Paris)  
  
*Please note these fees do not include food, accommodation or living expenses.*

## How does it work?

Check out the admission requirements for your chosen programme:

* Master in Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity
* M.Sc. Management of Technology - Information systems

Prepare the documents you will need to send:

* An up-to-date CV
* Copy of your passport
* Official transcripts from all of your higher education
* Certified copy of your degree certificate(s)
* 2 letters of recommendation (use the reference form if you wish)
* Proof of English level, if necessary
* A personal statement\* outlining your motivation and aptitude for the chosen programme

*\*ensure this is your own work. Statements containing copy-paste elements will be disregarded*
